MATCH (s:Soldier)
WHERE toLower(s.nom) CONTAINS toLower($nom)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       s.naissance_annee AS naissance_annee, s.naissance_lieu AS naissance_lieu,
       s.regiment AS regiment, s.matricule AS matricule
ORDER BY s.nom, s.prenom

MATCH (s:Soldier)
WHERE toLower(s.nom) CONTAINS toLower($nom)
  AND toLower(s.prenom) CONTAINS toLower($prenom)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       s.naissance_annee AS naissance_annee, s.naissance_lieu AS naissance_lieu,
       s.regiment AS regiment, s.matricule AS matricule
ORDER BY s.nom, s.prenom

MATCH (s:Soldier)
WHERE s.enrolement_annee = $annee
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       s.enrolement_annee AS enrolement_annee,
       s.regiment AS regiment, s.grade_final AS grade_final
ORDER BY s.nom

MATCH (s:Soldier)
WHERE toLower(s.naissance_departement) CONTAINS toLower($departement)
   OR toLower(s.domicile_departement)  CONTAINS toLower($departement)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       s.naissance_departement AS naissance_departement,
       s.domicile_departement  AS domicile_departement,
       s.regiment AS regiment
ORDER BY s.nom

MATCH (s:Soldier)
WHERE s.deces_annee = $annee
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:DIED_IN]->(p:Place)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       s.deces_jour AS deces_jour, s.deces_mois AS deces_mois, s.deces_annee AS deces_annee,
       p.lieu AS deces_lieu, p.pays AS deces_pays
ORDER BY s.nom

MATCH (s:Soldier)-[h:HELD_RANK]->(r:Rank)
WHERE h.order = 'final'
  AND toLower(r.nom) CONTAINS toLower($grade)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       r.nom AS grade_final, s.regiment AS regiment
ORDER BY s.nom

MATCH (s:Soldier)-[r:DESERTED_FROM]->(reg:Regiment)
RETURN s.nom AS nom, s.prenom AS prenom, s.surnom AS surnom,
       reg.nom AS regiment,
       r.jour AS desertion_jour, r.mois AS desertion_mois, r.annee AS desertion_annee
ORDER BY s.nom

MATCH (s:Soldier)

MATCH (s:Soldier)-[:BORN_IN]->(p:Place)
WHERE toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'breton' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'bretagne'
   OR toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'alsacien' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'alsace'
WITH s,
     CASE
       WHEN toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'breton' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'bretagne' THEN 'breton'
       WHEN toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'alsacien' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'alsace' THEN 'alsacien'
     END AS region,
     CASE
       WHEN toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'breton' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'bretagne' THEN toFloat(s.taille_metre)
       WHEN toLower(p.lieu) CONTAINS 'alsacien' OR toLower(p.region) CONTAINS 'alsace' THEN toFloat(s.taille_metre)
     END AS taille
WHERE s.taille_metre IS NOT NULL AND region IS NOT NULL
RETURN region, round(avg(taille)*1000.0)/1000.0 AS taille_moyenne_metres
